label: setup
js: (() => { document.getElementById('hud').style.display = 'none'; const sp = document.querySelector('#hud ~ div'); window.__view = (px, py, pz, lx, ly, lz, mm) => { const r = __kk.rig; const P = r.cam.position.clone().set(px, py, pz), L = r.cam.position.clone().set(lx, ly, lz); r.presets[9] = { name: 'view', pos: () => P.clone(), look: () => L.clone(), mm, dof: 0, focus: () => 10 }; __kk.preset(9); }; return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const k = __kk.kitten; const p = k.body.pos; const f = { x: Math.sin(k.body.yaw), z: Math.cos(k.body.yaw) }; __view(p.x + f.x * 0.85 - f.z * 0.12, p.y + 0.2, p.z + f.z * 0.85 + f.x * 0.12, p.x, p.y + 0.21, p.z, 50); })()
